title: 2000 AMC12 3
statement: Each day, Jenny ate \(20\%\) of the jellybeans that were in her jar at the beginning of that day. At the end of the second day, \(32\) remained. How many jellybeans were in the jar originally?

solutions.text:
Since \(20\%\) is eaten each day, \(80\%\) remains at the end of each day. If \(x\) is the original number, then \[ (0.8)^2 x = 32. \]

Solving gives \(0.64x = 32,\) so \(x = 50.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Eating \(20\%\) leaves \(80\%\) at the end of each day
